reason: The gap is real but the claim frames it wrongly. The 8/27 decision has two parts: Sign-Up currency defaults from the Deal market country (L2125/L2138/L2139), and Player currency defaults from Player country (L2145/L2146). WAGR-404, WAGR-160 and the 9/18 change (L2704) are all about the Player-level Signup Currency field, so they match the 8/27 Player decision and do not contradict it. What is actually missing is a ticket to default Sign_Up__c.Signup_Currency__c (created in WAGR-7) from the Deal market country, stamped on the record and editable by Ops. No WAGR ticket covers that. I lowered severity to Medium because separate payout currency work is deferred to payouts discovery (L2140; WAGR-465 is in Requirements).
q1: Found. I re-fetched doc 1LL6tMq9tPMMnfKLg5AGRRz9ps6Tk6Yt6-3uqWMW3Cn0 as text/html and converted it with gdoc_html2txt.py (269 lines). Every segment of the L2125, L2128, L2138, L2139 and L2124 quotes matches verbatim after whitespace normalization. The only differences are dropped 'um'/'uh' filler words.
q2: Partly supports the claim. In context (lines 60-269), Emily confirms the Deal market country, not the commercial-terms currency, sets the sign-up payout currency (00:05:40). Kobi proposes defaulting the sign-up currency from the deal's market country with Ops able to edit it (00:11:53). Emily agrees, and at 00:16:16 she restates 'for sign up then you'll go with market country from the deal'. That part is a real, client-confirmed decision. But at 00:14:08 and 00:16:16 the same call also decides that Player currency defaults from Player country, stays editable and has no effect on sign-ups. The claim leaves this out. So 'Jira derives it from Player country' is in line with 8/27 for the Player record. It is a variance only for the Sign-Up record. Also, Kobi's line 'we shouldn't just automatically use formula fields based on player' at 00:04:35 is about the sign-up, not the player field.
q3: No later meeting reverses the sign-up rule. L2704 (9/18 internal) has Taryn pointing the 'sign up currency formula field' at the OOTB currency field 'so that it captures the players country of origin'. That is the Player-level field from WAGR-404, which matches L2145, so it does not supersede the Sign-Up rule. L2749/L2750/L2874/L3187 (9/21-9/28) are about Player currency defaulting to CAD (WAGR-413/415). L3163/L3120/L3121 (9/25 payouts discovery) refine the model: each signup carries a player-payment currency and a referrer-payout currency, the referrer currency defaults from the referrer and the BA can override it per signup. This adds requirements but does not reverse the deal-market-country default for the sign-up currency. L3415 (9/30) stamps the commercial-terms currency on the signup for reporting. That is a different concept: Emily said on 8/27 that the deal currency is not the payout currency.
q4: Jira does not cover the Sign-Up default. WAGR-404 (description, plus one comment from Taryn Reithofer on 2026-09-18) and WAGR-160 (3 comments) define and build a Player-record Signup Currency from Player country/CurrencyIsoCode. WAGR-413 (5 comments, Cedrick) confirms the SLC flow SLC_After_Save_Player_DRA_and_Sign_Up sets Player CurrencyIsoCode from Player_Country__c. WAGR-415 (0 comments) tracks missing country data from the CMS. WAGR-7 (Done) creates Sign_Up__c.Signup_Currency__c as a CAD/USD picklist but defines no default logic. WAGR-5 mentions only 'player creation with currency derivation' (all 12 comments checked; none mention sign-up currency). WAGR-106 is about snapshotting commercial terms. JQL searches run: text~'currency' (43 issues), text~'"market country"' (33 issues), and text~'"payout currency"' OR '"signup currency"' OR '"sign-up currency"' OR 'CurrencyIsoCode' (17 issues). No ticket sets Sign-Up currency from the Deal market country.
corrections: WAGR-404 comment 2026-09-18 author is Taryn Reithofer (not 'not recorded').

WAGR-404 and WAGR-160 cover the Player-record field, which matches the 8/27 Player decision L2145/L2146. Record this as a missing Sign-Up story (close to V1) against Sign_Up__c.Signup_Currency__c from WAGR-7, not as a contradiction of WAGR-404.

L2704 (9/18) is about the Player-level formula field. Do not present it as a conflicting Sign-Up rule. The suggested action 'confirm which rule is current' should become 'confirm the Sign-Up default from Deal market country and ticket it'. The Player rule is already agreed.
Add the 8/27 Player-currency decision (L2145, L2146) to the evidence for completeness.
Related open question: the combined US+Canada market country value (L2131/L2152). WAGR-252 'retire combined WT_Market values' is Done, which supports a simple CAD/USD mapping.
WAGR-413 assignee is now Cedrick Infantado (the claim does not cite it, but it is related).
